description: The legacy .Site.Author API and author configuration were deprecated in Hugo 0.124.0. Use a site parameter or an authors taxonomy instead.
The legacy .Site.Authors API was deprecated in Hugo 0.124.0 and subsequently removed. Use site parameters or an authors taxonomy.
The legacy .Site.Social API was deprecated in Hugo 0.124.0 and subsequently removed. Use site parameters or a social taxonomy.
The legacy site-level multilingual check was deprecated in favor of the global Hugo API.
The legacy .Site.IsMultiLingual API was deprecated in Hugo 0.124.0 and later disabled as a deprecated API.
The obsolete .Site.HomeAbsURL API was removed.
The legacy --debug command-line option was deprecated and subsequently removed.
The legacy --verbose command-line option was deprecated and subsequently removed. The recommended replacement is the log level option.
The site-level IsServer method was deprecated in favor of the global Hugo API.
The legacy Disqus site method was deprecated and later disabled.
The legacy Google Analytics site method was deprecated and later disabled.
The legacy LastChange site method was renamed to Lastmod.
The First site accessor was deprecated in favor of the Default site accessor.
The legacy top-level paginate configuration key was deprecated in favor of the pagination configuration namespace.
The legacy paginatePath configuration key was deprecated in favor of the pagination configuration namespace.
The legacy paginator PageSize property was renamed to PagerSize.
The legacy NextPage method was replaced by Next.
The legacy PrevPage method was replaced by Prev.
The legacy getJSON function was removed. Remote resources should be fetched with resources.GetRemote and decoded with transform.Unmarshal.
The legacy getCSV function was removed. Remote resources should be fetched and decoded using the resource pipeline.
The legacy crypto.FNV32a function was moved to the hash namespace.
The Babel resource transformation moved to the js namespace.
The PostCSS resource transformation moved to the css namespace.
The legacy ToCSS resource transformation was removed in favor of the css.Sass pipeline.
The built-in twitter_simple shortcode was removed. The x shortcode provides the replacement.
The legacy Twitter shortcode was removed in favor of the X shortcode.
The built-in gist shortcode was deprecated and subsequently removed.
The Twitter service configuration was renamed to reflect the X service.
Resource.Err was deprecated in favor of the try function.
The taxonomyterm terminology was deprecated in favor of taxonomy terminology.
The page Scratch store was deprecated in favor of Store.
The shortcode Scratch store was deprecated in favor of Store.
The :filename permalink token was deprecated in favor of :contentbasename.
The :slugorfilename permalink token was deprecated in favor of :slugorcontentbasename.
The underscore-prefixed cascade target was deprecated in favor of cascade.target.
The lang option on module mounts was deprecated as Hugo introduced multidimensional site targeting.
The lang option on segments was deprecated in favor of multidimensional site targeting.
The includeFiles mount filter was deprecated in favor of the unified files filter.
The excludeFiles mount filter was deprecated in favor of the unified files filter supporting negation.
LibSass was deprecated in favor of Dart Sass.
The legacy top-level minifyOutput configuration was deprecated in favor of the minify configuration namespace.
Resource.Exif was deprecated in favor of the unified Resource.Meta metadata API.
Site.Data was deprecated because data belongs to the project rather than one individual site.
Site.Sites was deprecated because sites belong to the project-level multidimensional model.
Page.Sites was deprecated because sites belong to the project-level multidimensional model.
Site.AllPages was deprecated because it returns pages across all sites and dimensions.
Site.Languages was deprecated as Hugo moved toward dimension-aware page translation and site APIs.
Site.BuildDrafts was deprecated. It represents a build setting rather than page-level draft state.
Language.Lang was deprecated in favor of Language.Name.
Language.Lang was deprecated in favor of Language.Name.
LanguageCode was deprecated in favor of the more precise Locale API.
Site.Language.LanguageCode was deprecated in favor of Locale.
LanguageDirection was deprecated in favor of Direction.
Site.Language.LanguageDirection was deprecated in favor of Direction.
LanguageName was deprecated in favor of Label.
LanguageName was deprecated in favor of Label.
The Language.Weight method was deprecated as the language dimension is represented by the newer language API.
The template Language.Weight method was deprecated. The language configuration weight remains relevant for sorting.
The legacy Site.LanguageCode API was deprecated in favor of Language.Locale.
The languageCode configuration key was deprecated in favor of locale.
The languageName configuration key was deprecated in favor of label.
The languageDirection configuration key was deprecated in favor of direction.
Hugo 0.146.0 introduced the new template system. Templates previously under layouts/_default are moved to the layouts root.
Hugo 0.146.0 changed the template structure and renamed the partials directory to _partials.
The new template system renamed the shortcodes directory to _shortcodes.
The home page template changed from index.html to home.html under the new template system.
Section templates moved from the section directory to the root layout namespace.
Taxonomy and term templates moved into the root template namespace.
Template naming changed so the template kind/type identifier moves after the first dot.
Hugo 0.146.0 revised the template system. Existing _internal template usage may still work, but the _internal namespace is now being deprecated; use partials instead.
The new template system introduced the _markup template namespace for markup-related templates.
Page.IsNode was deprecated in favor of the more precise IsBranch API.
The global Imaging.Compression setting was deprecated and moved to format-specific image configuration.
The global imaging quality setting was deprecated in favor of per-format quality settings. Hugo 0.163.0 also changed the AVIF default quality to 60.
resources.PostProcess was deprecated because templates.Defer provides a more flexible deferred rendering mechanism.
Hugo 0.161.0 introduced Node.js permission enforcement for PostCSS, Babel and TailwindCSS.
usageBefore: Node tools execute without Hugo-managed Node permissions.

description: Hugo 0.161.0 requires Node.js 22 or later for the Node-based processing affected by the new permission model.

replacement: Tailwind CSS CLI installed as a Node.js package
description: The standalone Tailwind CSS executable is no longer supported by css.TailwindCSS.
usageAfter: Install Tailwind CSS CLI as a Node package.

description: Hugo 0.161.1 added AllowChildProcess to the Node permission configuration to handle tools that need child-process access.
Hugo 0.162.0 introduced security.allowContent to control which content media types are allowed.
usageBefore: HTML content files are allowed by default.

description: text/html content is denied by default starting in Hugo 0.162.0. Sites that intentionally use HTML content must explicitly allow it.
Org content is also denied by default because Org export can emit raw HTML.
Hugo 0.162.0 added AVIF image encoding and decoding support.
A partial reference beginning with ./ or ../ is resolved relative to the directory of the calling partial.
The slug front matter field now works for section, taxonomy and term pages and cascades to descendants.
usageBefore: slug on branch pages is not applied.

description: The root cleanDestinationDir configuration key was deprecated in favor of the build.cleanDestinationDir configuration.
The .URL page variable was removed.
The .RSSLink page variable was removed.
The .IsDraft page variable was removed.
Legacy uglyURLs configuration should be reviewed during migration.
Legacy pagination size APIs were deprecated in favor of the current paginator configuration and methods.
Twitter service/privacy configuration was renamed to reflect the X service.
The built-in comment shortcode was deprecated.

replacement: plainify when plain text is required
description: Generated summaries can contain HTML markup. Use plainify when a plain-text summary is required.
LanguageDirection was deprecated in favor of Direction.
LanguageName was deprecated in favor of Label.
The 'disablePathToLower' configuration key was deprecated and replaced by 'disablepathtolower'.
